text:
alex (ml-eng): starting Beacon LoRA merge for customer Beacon. customer requires exact invoice tokenization (currency symbols, thousand separators, non-breaking spaces). quickpack against beacon_invoice_qpack now.
sam (applied-ml): do we have the customer's tokenizer remap? last time stitch caused offset shifts.
alex (ml-eng): stitch applied via adapter-stitch v2 with map_tokens=true. eval command:
```
./run_eval --model redwood-4x@beacon-lora-v2 --dataset beacon_invoice_qpack.json --metrics amount_exact,separator_preserve,latency_p50
```
initial results:
```
{"amount_exact":"0.83","separator_preserve":"0.76","latency_p50_ms":"71"}
```
jamie (qa): separator_preserve at 0.76 is a hard fail. failing examples show tokens split across adapter boundary: "$" + "1,000.00" tokenized into "$1", ",000", ".00" and later reconstructed without the thin-space. also saw CLS/BOS misalignment in a few cases.
sam (applied-ml): mitigation ideas: (1) graft adapter only to MLP layers (avoid LN/output), (2) try per-channel int3 quant instead of int4 per-tensor, (3) add tokenizer roundtrip checks and a separator-preserve CI.
alex (ml-eng): building mlp-only graft + int3 per-channel now. artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/beacon/redwood-4x-beacon-lora-mlp-only-int3-pc.tar.gz sha256=5f2d1c...
build-bot: artifact verified, integration tests passed (smoke).
deployer: canary scheduled env=staging percent=1 start=2026-03-24T09:00:00Z rollback_on=separator_preserve<0.95 or amount_exact<0.94
jamie (qa): re-run locally with new artifact:
```
./run_eval --model s3://.../redwood-4x-beacon-lora-mlp-only-int3-pc.tar.gz --dataset beacon_invoice_qpack.json
```
new results:
```
{"amount_exact":"0.953","separator_preserve":"0.96","latency_p50_ms":"79"}
```
sam (applied-ml): that looks acceptable. next steps: add strict regex checks for thousand separators and currency adjacency in CI, and run tokenizer token_roundtrip for 5k examples to catch remap edgecases.
alex (ml-eng): token_roundtrip run started -> failures 12/5000, most around narrow no-break spaces (U+202F) and non-breaking thin space differences. plan: normalize NBSP variants to canonical thin-space in storage layer, but preserve original display in responses. enable fallback route for amount-sensitive endpoints until 24h shadow is clean.
jamie (qa): I'll watch shadow metrics and run extended locale packs (fr,de,es). set alert: separator_mismatch_rate>0.02 -> pager.
sam (applied-ml): document ablation: graft=MLP-only vs MLP+LN, quant=int3 per-channel vs int4 per-tensor, perf tradeoffs in rollout doc. include token_roundtrip summary.
alex (ml-eng): PR opened w/ test matrix + rollout notes. assigning monitoring for 48h. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
